Owen McCann: Quick one 101 1 ScandiMetrics AB sent invoice SM-2026-183 with a 25% VAT line for consulting services to Redwood Ireland (billing address on invoice). They did NOT include their VAT number and didn't mark the supply as reverse-charge. Should we hold payment until corrected invoice or process and reclaim?

Leila Moretti: If the buyer is an EU VAT-registered business (Redwood Ireland) for B2B services, supplier should not charge Swedish VAT; the reverse-charge mechanism normally applies. We need the supplier VAT ID and our Irish VAT ID shown on the invoice and a statement like "reverse charge - Article 44" or "VAT to be accounted for by the recipient".

Karim El-Sayed: Procurement note: ScandiMetrics says these are platform integration hours and they bill from their Stockholm entity. They supplied a scanned VAT certificate but no VAT number on the invoice PDF. I asked them to reissue.

Owen McCann: I replied requesting: (1) corrected invoice with their VAT number, (2) include Redwood Ireland VAT ID (IE1234567V) and reverse-charge wording, (3) a credit note for the VAT amount if they re-issue net. Holding payment until we get corrected docs.

Leila Moretti: Also run their VAT ID through VIES to confirm validity: https://ec.europa.eu/taxation_customs/vies/ - if VIES returns valid, we can record the reverse-charge for Irish VAT accounting. If VIES invalid, escalate to tax for manual checks and possible supplier registration issues.

Karim El-Sayed: If they insist they're obliged to charge Swedish VAT (e.g., selling to non-VAT-registered buyer) we should ask for evidence of customer VAT status. We have a business-to-business order and our procurement entry shows Redwood Ireland VAT ID, so vendor should zero-rate under reverse-charge.

Owen McCann: Payment-bot set a 5-business-day hold and reminder.

payment-bot: Reminder set: follow up on SM-2026-183 in 5 business days.

Leila Moretti: For month-end: if vendor refuses to correct and we pay VAT, we'll need a supplier credit note or claim via our VAT return reconciliation. Also keep copy of correspondence and VIES check.

Karim El-Sayed: Also tagging AP: code ledger as "purchase-services - VAT disputed" so accruals show gross amount until resolved.

Owen McCann: Thanks 101 1 everyone 101 1 I'll update when they resend the invoice.
